articles.summary: APi Group Corporation (NYSE: APG) (“APi”) announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Thursday, October 29, 2026. Third Quarter Earnings Conference Call: APi will host a webcast and conference call to discuss its financial results at 8:30 a.m. ET on Thursday, October 29, 2026. Participants on the call will include Russell A. Becker, President and Chief Executive Officer, and David Jackola, EVP and Chief Financial Officer. The conference call can be accessed by registering online using the links below. Analysts will receive dial-in information as well as a conference ID once registered. Webcast Link: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/894181837 Analysts Link: https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/894181837?pwd=ecOlF7Kh A replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the live event via the webcast link above.
